cards.title: The Knesset
cards.subtitle: 120 seats · one chamber · one country-wide ballot
cards.body: Israel’s parliament has 120 members in a single chamber. You do not elect a local MK. The whole country is one constituency. Seats are divided among lists that clear the threshold, in proportion to their valid votes. A government needs 61 seats.
cards.whyItMatters: You are voting for a list’s share of 120, not for a neighborhood representative.
cards.source: Basic Law: The Knesset, art. 4; Knesset electoral-system lexicon.

cards.title: The Kalpi
cards.subtitle: The ballot box · you vote for a list
cards.body: At the kalpi you take one paper slip for one submitted list and put it in the box. Legally you vote for a closed list, not a person. If that list wins 18 seats, the first 18 names on it enter the Knesset, unless someone resigns later. The slip is secret.
cards.whyItMatters: Knowing who sits in slots 1–20 is how you know who your vote can actually seat.
cards.source: Knesset Elections Law (combined version), 1969; IDI “How Votes Become Knesset Seats.”

cards.title: The Threshold
cards.subtitle: 3.25% of valid votes
cards.body: Since 2015 a list needs 3.25% of valid votes to take any seats. Votes for lists under the line stay “valid” on the tally, but they elect nobody. In 2022 the seat quota after the threshold was about 36,227 votes. Small lists near the line can move several seats between blocs.
cards.whyItMatters: A protest slip that misses 3.25% does not become a protest MK.
cards.source: IDI explainer, 2026; Knesset 25th-election results.

cards.title: Central Elections Committee
cards.subtitle: Lists due 9 Sept 2026 · election 27 Oct 2026
cards.body: The CEC runs the election: it takes the lists, assigns ballot letters, and publishes results. Parties must file candidate lists by 9 September 2026. Israelis abroad vote at missions from 20 October. Election day is Tuesday 27 October 2026. Results are confirmed later.
cards.whyItMatters: Until 9 September, every “final list” you see in a pack is still a report, not a filed slate.
